news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: ₹4.26 loss per share (vs ₹6.28 loss in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: ₹4.26 loss per share (improved from ₹6.28 loss in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹37.6m (up 45% from FY 2025). Net loss: ₹8.59m (loss narrowed 32% from FY 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 80 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.

news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 3 experienced directors. 2 highly experienced directors. 2 independent directors (3 non-independent directors). Non-Executive & Independent Director Dinesh Goel was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2021. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Minority of independent directors. Insufficient board refreshment.
